prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
Provision for credit losses for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $4.3 million and $11.0 million, respectively, as compared to $4.1 million and $12.5 million for the corresponding prior year periods. The current quarter provision reflected continuing stable asset quality.

Net loan charge-offs were $1.5 million and $3.7 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $617,000 and $3.5 million for the corresponding prior year periods. Annualized net loan charge-offs to average total loans were 0.04% for both the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to 0.02% and 0.05% for the corresponding prior year periods.

tax.text: The provision for income taxes was $13.0 million and $20.1 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $5.2 million and $17.7 million for the same prior year periods. The effective tax rate was 44.2% and 37.2% for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to 22.9% and 23.4% for the same prior year periods. The effective tax rate for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 was adversely impacted by non-deductible merger-related expenses. The effective tax rate for the nine-month period was partially offset by the revaluation of deferred taxes as a result of the Flushing acquisition. Excluding the tax impact of non-deductible merger-related expenses, the effective tax rate would have been 26.6% and 29.5% for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively.

net.text: Net income available to common stockholders for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 included restructuring charges of $4.1 million for both periods, an FDIC special assessment release of $210,000 for both periods, and a net loss of $7,000 and net gain of $686,000 on equity investments, respectively. These items decreased net income by $3.0 million and $2.5 million, net of tax. Additionally, net income available to common stockholders for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 included a net loss on redemption of preferred stock of $1.8 million.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income and Margin
Net interest income.text: Net interest income for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased to $172.1 million and $389.3 million, respectively, as compared to $90.7 million and $264.9 million, reflecting the net impact of the acquisition of Flushing and the interest rate environment. Net interest margin increased to 3.18% and 3.07%, from 2.91% for both prior periods.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
